verdict_reason: OpenVINO cannot execute kokoro-v1.0.onnx: ovc converts the graph to IR, but the IR crashes at first inference on the CPU plugin (opset1::Broadcast inside /decoder/decoder/generator/istft/stft fails shape validation, dim 61 vs 19). Static-shape conversion crashes inside ovc itself (inconsistent Add shapes in the same istft subgraph); GPU plugin also fails (Interpolate linear_onnx rejects rank-3 input); OpenVINO 2025.4 fails even earlier (ONNX frontend rejects STFT-20 with dynamic signal shape). RTF/quality comparison vs ORT is therefore impossible - no honest numbers exist to report.

method_tooling.design: Mirrors E0024 quant_bench.py: isolated subprocess workers, kokoro_onnx.Kokoro wrapper driven identically for both backends via an OpenVINOSessionShim (run/get_inputs/get_outputs/_model_path surface) so ONLY the graph executor differs; same Caedral frontend (lexicon+g2pen) + DEFAULT_VOCAB as production engine; 10 warm reps + discarded cold call @ INFERENCE_NUM_THREADS=4 vs intra_op_num_threads=4; two opposite-order rounds; repo-standard classify_preview dual-ASR minWER + DNSMOS scoring.
method_tooling.status: Ready and unblocked if a future OpenVINO release fixes STFT/iSTFT execution; re-run parent to regenerate all numbers.

root_cause_analysis: The failure is localized to the fused iSTFT vocoder subgraph (/decoder/decoder/generator/istft/stft/*). The ONNX export computes STFT frame geometry through data-dependent shapes (duration predictor output), which ONNX Runtime evaluates correctly at runtime but OpenVINO resolves inconsistently across branches (61 vs 19) - both at runtime (CPU plugin) and at conversion-time constant folding (static probe). This is an upstream OpenVINO limitation, not a defect in the Kokoro export or the Caedral pipeline.
decision: Keep ONNX Runtime CPU EP as the production backend. Re-evaluate OpenVINO only after a major version bump (watch OpenVINO changelogs for ONNX STFT/iSTFT support fixes); reconversion takes ~5 s.
